pres.title: Guided defense presentation
pres.sub: Six safe steps in a fixed order — navigate with the two buttons; everything runs live.
pres.meth: Evaluation: StratifiedGroupKFold 5 folds × 5 repeats grouped by service (a service's two rows never straddle train/test) · prediction from the 13 pre-execution features only · balanced class weights.
pres.holdNote: Reserved holdout (v34 onward): 18 services (36 records, 20%) were set aside by a seed-42 service-grouped split; the official model comparison, seed study and tuning ran on the remaining 140 records, and the selected model was evaluated once on the holdout (11 July 2026). The holdout services had taken part in an earlier exploratory full-data round before the protocol was fixed, so the result is a post-selection check, not an independent confirmation (paper, Section 3.4 and Table A2).

cue.s1: A safe six-step path — and we will break its order on request: everything is live.

intro.label: About this page
intro.dashboard: The data gateway: where it came from, its size and class balance — every number computed live from the real project file.
intro.progress: Thesis progress map: done vs remaining — some items auto-color from the system's own state.
intro.present: The safe session path: six fixed steps covering the whole story, with one-click reset and restore.
intro.training: The system's heart: the full experiment (300 trainings) replays before your eyes with any seed — progress and timings live.
intro.results: The verdict tables: models compared under one strict protocol. Presentation mode leads with the hero; Expert mode shows full tables.
intro.xai: Why the model decides as it does: learned weights and feature importance — associations for prediction, not causal claims.
intro.predict: The decision tool: enter a migration case with your values and get the verdict, probabilities, reasons and actions.
intro.recommend: A codified expert system: eight transparent rules with historical evidence from the data itself — no generated text.
intro.dictionary: The 27-column reference: each column's meaning and role — the 13 official features highlighted.
intro.quality: Data integrity gates and documented cleaning decisions — even pending calls are shown transparently.
intro.exports: Chapter-4 outputs: thesis figures and tables generated live from the system's results.
intro.vault: A local versioned store for research documents — upload, note what changed, download any version.
intro.models: Serving-model archive: every model that ever served a prediction, documented with identity and fit scope.
intro.docsguide: In-app documentation: running the system, the two modes, links and the user manual.

gloss.macroF1: Mean F1 across the three classes with equal weight — the majority cannot drown the rare class. The pre-declared primary metric.
gloss.auc: Quality of probability ranking across all thresholds (one-vs-rest, macro-averaged).
gloss.protocol: Grouped stratified split: a service's Dev/QA twins never separate across train/test; 5 folds × 5 repeats = 25 exams per model; balanced class weights protect the rare class.
gloss.manifest: The experiment's full identity: data, seed, methodology, library versions — for literal reproducibility.
gloss.seed: A number that pins randomness so the experiment reproduces its exact figures on any machine. Declared 42; the field accepts any number.
